sources.title: Part 1: Client-side AI to combat online toxicity - web.dev
sources.snippet: Immediate detection in comment systems. Provide immediate feedback to users who draft toxic comments, encouraging them to rephrase their message before posting. With client-side AI, you can achieve this with no API key, no runtime server-side classification costs, and low latency. This can be ideal for chat apps. Real-time moderation in live chat.

sources.title: Toxic Comment Detector - GitHub
sources.snippet: The Toxic Comment Detector leverages Hugging Face's unitary/toxic-bert model to identify harmful, offensive, or abusive language in user-generated content. Built with a ReactJS (Vite) frontend and a Flask backend, this tool provides real-time toxicity analysis for enhancing online safety and moderation.
